rationale: After making a new session low at $180.80, the price failed to sustain downward continuation and has bounced sharply back above both the entry price ($184.29) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($185.89) on expanding 1-minute volume. Because the 5-minute 9-EMA served as the primary dynamic resistance in the entry thesis, reclaiming it breaks the immediate momentum structure and warrants exiting early rather than waiting for the $192.00 stop. A flip to long is not justified given the massive intraday downtrend well below session VWAP ($206.12) and ongoing broad market weakness (SPY -1.33%).
